name: MUDAJYA
recent: Mudajaya 股东在 2026 年 11 月 5 日的特别股东大会上批准了 Xelmont 以 2.34 亿港元（约 1.1845 亿令吉）向 Minyi Holdings 出售 Real Jade 45% 股权的提案，其中大部分以债务抵销方式结算。此前，双方于 2026 年 10 月 14 日同意将买卖协议的截止日期延长至 2026 年 11 月 27 日。此外，公司与中国交通建设的纠纷扩大，涉及 1760 万令吉的索赔。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上批准 Xelmont 以 2.34 亿港元出售 Real Jade 45% 股权给 Minyi Holdings，其中 2.4497 亿港元债务以抵销方式结算。
双方同意将股份买卖协议的截止日期从 2026 年 10 月 27 日延长至 2026 年 11 月 27 日。
公司与中国交通建设的纠纷扩大，涉及 1760 万令吉的索赔。
risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼，与中国交通建设的纠纷扩大至 1760 万令吉索赔。
拟议出售 Real Jade 45% 股权的买卖协议条件尚未完全满足，截止日期已延长至 2026 年 11 月 27 日。

news.title: Mudajaya, China Communications Construction dispute widens with RM17.6mil claim

events.what: 买卖协议截止日期延长

recent_en: Mudajaya shareholders approved at an EGM on 5 Nov 2026 the proposed disposal by Xelmont of a 45% stake in Real Jade to Minyi Holdings for HKD234.00 million (approx. RM118.45 million), largely settled via debt set-off. The parties had earlier on 14 Oct 2026 mutually agreed to extend the SSA cut-off date to 27 Nov 2026. Separately, the dispute with China Communications Construction widened with a RM17.6 million claim.
notable_en: Shareholders approved at an EGM the disposal by Xelmont of a 45% stake in Real Jade to Minyi Holdings for HKD234.00 million, with HKD244.97 million of debt settled via set-off.
The parties agreed to extend the cut-off date of the share sale agreement from 27 Oct 2026 to 27 Nov 2026.
The dispute with China Communications Construction widened with a RM17.6 million claim.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation, with the dispute with China Communications Construction widening to a RM17.6 million claim.
The conditions precedent for the proposed disposal of a 45% stake in Real Jade have not been fully fulfilled, and the cut-off date has been extended to 27 Nov 2026.
